# @verevoir/llm

Provider-agnostic LLM call surface with token + cost accounting.

## Purpose

Lets a downstream project make LLM calls with retry-friendly errors, token
accounting, per-direction cost tracking, and tool-calling, without coupling to a
specific provider SDK. Pick the provider you use via a subpath import; the unused
SDK does not enter your bundle.

## Subpaths

- `@verevoir/llm` — core types, the `chat()` / tool-calling contracts, cost
  accounting, and the model catalog + provider-routing helpers. No SDK dependency.
- `@verevoir/llm/anthropic` — Anthropic SDK adapter (`chat`, `chatWithTools`,
  `chatWithToolLoop`, live `onProgress`). Requires `@anthropic-ai/sdk`.
- `@verevoir/llm/google` — Google Gemini SDK adapter (`chat`, `chatWithTools`,
  `chatWithToolLoop` as of 0.13.0). Requires `@google/genai`.
- `@verevoir/llm/openai` — OpenAI adapter via the Responses API
  (`chat`; `chatWithTools` + `chatWithToolLoop` via the OpenAI-compatible factory).
  Requires `openai`. The only keyless-capable adapter: a base-URL override with a
  blank key points it at a local server (LM Studio / Ollama / vLLM).
- `@verevoir/llm/deepseek` — DeepSeek adapter, OpenAI-compatible via the Chat
  Completions API at `https://api.deepseek.com`. Reuses the `openai` peer — no
  separate SDK. `chat` + tool-calling.
- `@verevoir/llm/samba` — SambaNova adapter (`SAMBA_NOVA_API_KEY`),
  OpenAI-compatible. `chat` + tool-calling.
- `@verevoir/llm/mistral` — Mistral adapter (`MISTRAL_API_KEY`),
  OpenAI-compatible. `chat` + tool-calling.

Every provider in the matrix (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, DeepSeek, SambaNova,
Mistral) can now drive the tool loop.

## Install

```bash
npm install @verevoir/llm @anthropic-ai/sdk
```

The package's `peerDependencies` are marked optional — install only the SDK(s)
you import (`@anthropic-ai/sdk`, `@google/genai`, `openai`; the OpenAI-compatible
providers share `openai`).

## Canonical usage

```ts
import { anthropic } from '@verevoir/llm/anthropic';

const reply = await anthropic.chat({
  systemPrompt: '...',
  turns: [{ role: 'user', content: '...' }],
  apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY!,
  modelClass: 'reasoning', // 'reasoning' | 'drafting' | 'extraction'
});

// reply.content: string
// reply.usage:   { provider, model, direction, inputTokens, outputTokens, ... }
```

## Tool calling

Each adapter exposes, alongside `chat()`:
- `chatWithTools(options)` — single-shot; surfaces the model's `ToolUse[]` for
  the caller to execute.
- `chatWithToolLoop(options)` — runs model → execute tools → feed results back →
  repeat, to a `maxIterations` cap. Takes a `ToolExecutor` (`(toolUse) => Promise<string>`)
  plus per-iteration `onUsage` / `onIteration` hooks; usage is summed across the loop.

Provider-agnostic types `ToolDef`, `ToolUse`, `ToolExecutor`, `ContentBlock`
(`text` | `tool_use` | `tool_result`), and the `ChatWithTools*` /
`ChatWithToolLoop*` option/result shapes live on the core export.

## Cost accounting

Every call returns a `TokenUsage` typed
`{ provider, model, direction, inputTokens, outputTokens, ... }` (with optional
`cacheRead` / `cacheWrite` so prompt-cache savings price at their own rates). The
core export ships `sumUsages` / `parseUsage` to roll up across calls,
`totalTokens`, `formatTokensCompact` for compact displays, `estimateCostUSD`, and
`uncoveredModels` (loud-on-miss: which models a rates table doesn't cover) — so
usage converts to a cost estimate without external lookups.

The `direction` field carries the model-class semantic (`reasoning` /
`drafting` / `extraction`) so per-conversation / per-project rollups can break
down "spent X on reasoning + Y on extraction" natively.

## Model catalog + provider routing

Model identity is de-brittled — decisions key on `provider/family`, not the exact
version string, so a version bump doesn't zero a model's cost.

- `registerModelCatalog(entries)` / `ModelCatalogEntry` — an adapter declares each
  family once; `models` / `rates` / labels derive from it. `normalizeModelId(id)`
  resolves a drifted version forward to `{ provider, family }`; `catalogEntryFor`,
  `modelLabel`, `registerModelLabels` round it out.
- Provider connection registry — adapters register their connection on import, so
  routing can answer `isProviderConfigured` / `configuredProviders`,
  `providersForFamily(family)` (the inverse index), and `resolveModel({ family?, modelClass?, configuredOnly?, prefer? })`
  (cheapest configured by default). `resolveModelByTerm(term, opts)` resolves a
  loose human term ("deepseek") to a catalog entry; `modelConnection(term, opts)`
  returns a ready OpenAI-compatible `{ provider, modelId, baseUrl, apiKey }`.
- `<PROVIDER>_BASE_URL` overrides — every adapter honours an env override for its
  endpoint (`OPENAI_BASE_URL`, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, `GEMINI_BASE_URL` /
  `GOOGLE_BASE_URL`, `MISTRAL_BASE_URL`, `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL`, `SAMBA_NOVA_BASE_URL`),
  so a provider can be pointed at a gateway / proxy / regional / self-hosted
  endpoint without a code change. Routing sees only providers whose subpath has
  been imported.

## Status

Pre-stable: the `0.x` line communicates that the API surface can shift before
`1.0`. Track changes in the repo's CHANGELOG.
